home.metaTitle: Your own databases: tables, filters, statistics
home.title: Databases you define yourself
home.description: Build your own databases: define object types and their attributes, store records and follow statistics.

types.title: Your own object types
types.text: Tables with attributes you define yourself: text, number, yes/no, date, image, a reference to another record, lists and maps.

browse.title: Easy to browse
browse.text: Paged tables or a grid with filtering and sorting; deleted records can be restored.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.text: Saved filters and pivot-style statistics shown as tables and charts.

private.title: Private and colourful
private.text: Only you see your data, and every repository has a colour scheme of its own.

repository.title: Create a repository
repository.text: A repository is your database. Give it a name, a description and a colour scheme.

tables.title: Define tables and attributes
tables.text: In each table you choose your own attributes – text, number, yes/no, date, image, a reference to another record, a list or a map – and which of them are required.

records.title: Store records and follow them
records.text: Browse, filter and sort records, name the filters you use often, and have statistics drawn as tables and charts.

examples.title: What you can keep in it

collections.title: Collections and home inventories
collections.text: Books, films, records, tools or household items – with a photo, a note and the date you got them.

overviews.title: Records and overviews
overviews.text: Expenses, jobs, gifts or workouts: filter by period and get sums and averages by month.

links.title: Linked tables
links.text: Point from one record to another: a book to its author, a loan to a friend.
